findings.issue: `endOfPoint_corestrict` belongs in the earlier file `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/PointsAction.lean`, where `endOfPoint` is defined and where the other two variances of the same statement already live (`rTensor_comp_endOfPoint` for the value algebra, `baseChange_comp_endOfPoint` for the comodule). This is the third variance — functoriality in the coalgebra — and needs no Hopf algebra, no group of points, and no automorphism upgrade, which is the declared topic of the AlgebraicGroup-layer file it was put in. Its only later-layer dependency is `AlgHom.mapDomain` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Hopf/Map.lean), which is cosmetic: `(mapDomain φ g).ofConv` is `g.ofConv.comp φ` by `mapDomain_apply := rfl`.
